name: items-empty
description: An item section holding ZERO items. Splits 'the file grew' from 'the coins spawned'.
_comment: No 'tables' and no 'setup' on purpose. The overlay file is hand-written so
that ONLY the standalone copy changes -- bleck would also grow the copy
embedded in files/map/he1_01.bin, and that is a second variable.
If this boots, the coins are the problem, not the file growing.
